hero_lead: Turtle House Productions is a video and photography studio based in Weehawken, New Jersey. We create visual content for real estate, restaurants, hotels, hospitality businesses and brands across New Jersey and New York City.
statement: From the first shot to the final edit, we make content that helps people understand the space, the experience and the work behind a business.

faq.q: What does Turtle House Productions do?
faq.a: Turtle House Productions provides video production and photography for real estate, restaurants, hotels, luxury brands and service businesses. Services include planning, filming, photography, editing and social media versions.

faq.q: Where is Turtle House Productions based?
faq.a: Our studio is based in Weehawken, New Jersey, just across the Hudson River from Manhattan. We work throughout New Jersey and New York City, and travel for selected projects in Washington, DC and Northern Virginia.

faq.q: Which areas in New Jersey and New York do you serve?
faq.a: We work in Jersey City, Hoboken, Weehawken, Edgewater, Fort Lee and other parts of Hudson and Bergen County, as well as Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and Long Island City.

faq.q: Do you offer both video and photography?
faq.a: Yes. Depending on the project, we can plan and capture video and photography during the same production visit.

faq.q: How much does a video or photography project cost?
faq.a: Pricing depends on the location, production requirements, number of deliverables and intended use. Get in touch with a few details about your project and we’ll prepare a quote.
Send us the project location, the type of content you need and your preferred timing. We’ll follow up to discuss the scope and next steps.

seo_title: Turtle House Productions | Video Production in NJ & NYC
seo_desc: Video production and photography for real estate, restaurants, hotels and brands in New Jersey and New York City. Based in Weehawken, NJ.
reels_text: Most people will see your content on a phone. We create short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with thoughtful framing, strong opening shots and editing that fits each platform.
lux_text: We create films and photography for fine jewelry, watches, private aviation, yachts and high-end residential properties. These projects call for careful lighting, attention to detail and a considered approach to every shot.
Whether we’re filming a jewelry collection, an aircraft interior or a private residence, the goal is the same: present the subject at its best without making the work feel overproduced.

lux_items.title: Fine jewelry & watches
lux_items.text: Product films and photography for collections, boutiques, launches and private viewings. We pay close attention to reflections, materials and the details that make each piece distinctive.

lux_items.title: Private aviation
lux_items.text: Aircraft interiors, exterior details and airport or ramp footage for charter companies, operators and aviation brands. All filming is planned with the relevant operator and facility.

lux_items.title: Luxury homes & developments
lux_items.text: Property films and photography for distinctive homes, residential developments and real estate marketing.

lux_items.title: Yachts & private clubs
lux_items.text: On-water footage, interiors, amenities and event coverage for yacht and private-club businesses.

stories_h2: Hear it from the people who know the work.
stories_text: A finished project is important. Hearing directly from the person who experienced it can be just as valuable. We film relaxed, interview-led client stories that let homeowners and customers explain the process in their own words.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: We discuss your goals, audience, location and where the content will be used. Then we prepare a shot list and production plan for your approval.

steps.title: Film
steps.text: We arrive with a focused crew and a clear plan. When possible, we capture video and photography during the same visit and schedule around the location, people and available light.

steps.title: Edit & deliver
steps.text: We edit the footage, color-grade the videos, prepare the photographs and export the formats you need for your website, listings and social media.
